name: Begíjar (Spain)
description: Crimson field charged at the centre with the orange outline of the triumphal arch of the town hall doorway, flanked by four white stars.
history: After a year's work by a commission following the procedure laid down by the Junta de Andalucía, in 2018 the municipal council approved the proposal of the art historian Pedro Molina Martínez, and the flag was presented on 21 September 2018. The flag, on a crimson cloth, represents the doorway of the town hall, a great triumphal arch flanked by two fluted columns on pedestals and topped by a frieze, as a symbol of the union of all the people of Begíjar.

features.role: triumphal arch of the town hall doorway with two fluted columns
